intro: Playa del Rey is a small beach town at the south end of the Ballona Wetlands, with a short, walkable strip of bars and restaurants on Culver Boulevard and wide beaches where you can watch jets leave LAX.

ot: OpenTable diner reviews: Playa del Rey
gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A small neighborhood cafe with vintage photos of the area and solid breakfast sandwiches.
places.o: A croissant breakfast sandwich and a latte.

places.w: A tiny coffee bar with a patio over the wetlands and a Greek food truck out back. Open Wednesday through Sunday.
places.o: An iced latte and a Greek omelette from the truck.

places.w: A family-run Mexican restaurant cooking everything from scratch.
places.o: Chilaquiles at brunch or the fish tacos.

places.w: Chef Brooke Williamson's beachside spot with a daytime counter, a seafood dining room, a whiskey bar and house-made ice cream.
places.o: Crab claws and the lobster roll, then ice cream.

places.w: A Mediterranean small-plates restaurant and the neighborhood's go-to for a night out.
places.o: Share several small plates with a bottle of wine.

places.w: A Roman-run Italian restaurant serving fresh pasta near the beach since 1997, with a heated back patio.
places.o: A pasta and a glass of Italian red.

places.w: A wide beach with fire pits, a bike path and jets taking off from LAX right overhead.
places.o: Arrive early on weekends to claim a fire pit.
